allow: Bash(# Try Windows-style path for supabase config ls ""C:/Users/b-tho/AppData/Roaming/supabase/"" || ls ""C:/Users/b-tho/AppData/Local/supabase/"" # Also check where scoop installs supabase config ls ""/c/Users/b-tho/scoop/apps/supabase/current/"")
Bash(# Check where supabase stores its auth in scoop context find ""/c/Users/b-tho/scoop/apps/supabase"" -type f)

Bash(# Supabase CLI on Windows stores config in AppData\\Local\\supabase ls ""/c/Users/b-tho/AppData/Local/supabase/"" && echo ""found local"" || echo ""not found local"" # Try to find where supabase auth is stored find ""/c/Users/b-tho/AppData"" -name ""*.json"" | xargs grep -l ""supabase.io"")
